changed: A waiting standby's view periods publish its status. host::recover::stand_by publishes, from each role read of a waiting role, a link status with phase Standby, the shard record's (g, owner, E) as its target and no tenure, whose report entry carries no tenure and no serving state and the role Standby or Unrecorded, through the status cell the owner's phases use. Within a longer view period, and after a failed role read, it publishes the last successful read's status again once that status's last accepted publication is STATUS_US old or the cell refused it, while the read is less than STALE_US old, and a witness that arrives within the period ends it. Before this change the wait published nothing, so the host agent sealed no entry for a waiting standby and nominated no waiting process. The host agent's report rule (REPORT-PER-PERIOD) adds the condition under which it seals a Standby status's entry, the producer-missing gauge credits no owned role from such an entry, a Standby status gives no heartbeat entry, and a status without a tenure leaves the volume's progress baseline. The readers of a standby entry change with its first production producer (HEADROOM in failover::standbys): Census::pending, and through it Population::admit, Reconciler::reserve and the zone loop's plan, credit a standby-role entry against a census entry's attachment charge only when it names the active volume of a record the caller holds for that shard at the census entry's generation or a later one, and keep the charge when the caller holds no such record; before this change they matched the shard and the role alone, so after a flip the entry for the earlier volume stood in for an attach of the new one. Population::admit and Reconciler::reserve take that evidence as a new argument, and the zone loop's reservation step passes the records of its tick's survey, so the plan and the reservation credit the same entries. The wait reads its nominations at least once between two calls of its period signal, each bounded by half a detector window (Signals::window_us). The report contract's entries.role text states the waiting producer's rule; the host report, the link layout and the reconciler status keep their layouts and schema numbers.

property_action.reason: Its invariant states the new contract of the wait (STANDBY-PUBLISHES in host::recover) and the agent's seal rule for a Standby status. The census case, the report-entry case and the nomination case run the production wait and feed its statuses to the real agent; the alarm case evaluates the entry host::recover::standing builds; the agent and zone-loop reader cases use statuses and entries built to the wait's shape. Two controls: a wait that publishes nothing and a wait that publishes each read only once per view period.
